coverage: 31 proposed identities in both final live editions; paragraph-gated names, appearances and trial roles. Context-restricted aliases; inset-story figures excluded.
coordinateBase: after uses one-based chapters and zero-based paragraph indices

entities.name: Alice
entities.subtitle: The girl at the centre of the story
entities.body: Alice is sitting beside her sister on a bank. The story follows her thoughts and what she notices.

entities.name: Alice’s sister
entities.subtitle: Alice’s companion on the bank
entities.body: Alice’s unnamed sister is reading beside her on the bank.

entities.name: The White Rabbit
entities.subtitle: The rabbit Alice notices
entities.body: A White Rabbit with pink eyes runs close past Alice as she sits on the bank.

entities.name: Dinah
entities.subtitle: Remembered from home
entities.body: Alice thinks of Dinah while falling down the rabbit-hole and wonders whether she will be missed at home.

snapshots.name: Dinah
snapshots.body: Dinah is Alice’s cat at home. Falling down the rabbit-hole, Alice remembers her milk at teatime and wishes she were with her.

entities.name: The Mouse
entities.subtitle: Another swimmer in the pool
entities.body: Alice notices a mouse swimming in the pool of tears. She has become small enough to share the water with it.

entities.name: The Dodo
entities.subtitle: One of the creatures in the pool
entities.body: The Dodo is among the birds and animals that have fallen into the pool with Alice.

entities.name: The Duck
entities.subtitle: One of the birds in the pool
entities.body: The Duck is one of the birds Alice encounters in the pool of tears.

entities.name: The Lory
entities.subtitle: One of the birds in the pool
entities.body: The Lory belongs to the company of birds and animals in the pool of tears.

entities.name: The Eaglet
entities.subtitle: One of the birds in the pool
entities.body: The Eaglet is among the creatures sharing the pool with Alice.

entities.name: Pat
entities.subtitle: Called by the White Rabbit
entities.body: The White Rabbit calls angrily for Pat while Alice is trapped inside the house.

entities.name: Bill
entities.subtitle: A helper outside the Rabbit’s house
entities.body: Bill is named among the helpers gathering outside the house where Alice is trapped.

snapshots.name: Bill the Lizard
snapshots.body: Bill is the small lizard among the Rabbit’s helpers. Alice sees him supported by two guinea-pigs after the attempt to send him down the chimney.

snapshots.name: Bill the Lizard
snapshots.body: Bill the Lizard is now one of the jurors. Alice takes his squeaking pencil, leaving him to try to write on his slate with a finger.

entities.name: The Caterpillar
entities.subtitle: The creature on the mushroom
entities.body: Alice finds a large blue caterpillar on top of a mushroom as she looks for a way to change her size.

entities.name: The Pigeon
entities.subtitle: A bird among the treetops
entities.body: A pigeon confronts Alice among the leaves after her neck has grown high above the trees.

entities.name: The Fish-Footman
entities.subtitle: The visitor at the door
entities.body: A footman comes out of the wood towards the house Alice is watching.

entities.name: The Frog-Footman
entities.subtitle: The attendant at the door
entities.body: A second footman opens the door of the house Alice is watching.

entities.name: The Duchess
entities.subtitle: Named by the anxious Rabbit
entities.body: The White Rabbit mentions the Duchess while hurrying past Alice. Alice has not yet met her.

snapshots.name: The Duchess
snapshots.body: Alice finds the Duchess seated in a smoky kitchen, holding a baby while the cook tends a cauldron of soup.

entities.name: The Duchess’s cook
entities.subtitle: The cook in the kitchen
entities.body: The cook is in the smoky kitchen where Alice finds the Duchess holding a baby.

entities.name: The Duchess’s baby
entities.subtitle: The baby in the kitchen
entities.body: The Duchess is holding a baby when Alice enters the kitchen.

snapshots.name: The Duchess’s baby
snapshots.body: The baby Alice carried out of the kitchen has turned into a pig. Alice now sees the change beyond doubt.

entities.name: The cat in the kitchen
entities.subtitle: The cat Alice notices
entities.body: A large cat sits in the Duchess’s kitchen among the cook and the sneezing household.

snapshots.name: The Cheshire Cat
snapshots.body: The Duchess identifies the grinning creature in her kitchen as a Cheshire cat.

entities.name: The Hatter
entities.subtitle: A neighbour named by the Cat
entities.body: The Cat names a Hatter while giving Alice directions. Alice has not yet met him.

snapshots.name: The Hatter
snapshots.body: The Hatter is taking tea with the March Hare beneath a tree. They lean on a sleeping Dormouse between them.

entities.name: The March Hare
entities.subtitle: A neighbour named by the Cat
entities.body: The Cat names the March Hare while giving Alice directions. Alice has not yet met him.

snapshots.name: The March Hare
snapshots.body: The March Hare is taking tea with the Hatter outside his house. A sleeping Dormouse lies between them.

entities.name: The Dormouse
entities.subtitle: A companion at the tea-table
entities.body: The Dormouse sits between the March Hare and the Hatter at their outdoor tea-table.

entities.name: Two
entities.subtitle: One of the rose-painting gardeners
entities.body: Two is one of the three gardeners painting the white roses red near the garden entrance.

entities.name: Five
entities.subtitle: One of the rose-painting gardeners
entities.body: Five is one of the three gardeners Alice sees painting white roses red.

entities.name: Seven
entities.subtitle: One of the rose-painting gardeners
entities.body: Seven is a fellow gardener named by Five during the argument over splashed paint.

entities.name: The Queen
entities.subtitle: The sender of an invitation
entities.body: The Queen is named in an invitation delivered to the Duchess. Alice has not yet met her.

snapshots.name: The Queen of Hearts
snapshots.body: The Queen of Hearts arrives at the end of the royal procession with the King. She is the Queen whose invitation the footmen delivered to the Duchess.

entities.name: The King of Hearts
entities.subtitle: The king in the royal procession
entities.body: The King belongs to the royal procession Alice encounters in the garden.

snapshots.name: The King of Hearts
snapshots.body: The King of Hearts is presiding as judge at the trial. He wears his crown on top of his judicial wig.

entities.name: The Knave of Hearts
entities.subtitle: A member of the royal procession
entities.body: The Knave of Hearts is part of the procession Alice watches in the garden.

snapshots.name: The Knave of Hearts
snapshots.body: The Knave of Hearts carries the King’s crown on a crimson velvet cushion in the royal procession.

snapshots.name: The Knave of Hearts
snapshots.body: The Knave stands in chains before the court, accused of taking the Queen’s tarts. The accusation is being tried; it is not proof of guilt.

entities.name: The Gryphon
entities.subtitle: A creature encountered with the Queen
entities.body: Alice comes upon the Gryphon while accompanying the Queen.

entities.name: The Mock Turtle
entities.subtitle: A creature named by the Queen
entities.body: The Queen asks Alice whether she has met the Mock Turtle. Alice has not yet done so.

snapshots.name: The Mock Turtle
snapshots.body: Alice finds the Mock Turtle sitting miserably on a rocky ledge. He sighs as though his heart would break, while the Gryphon dismisses his sorrow.

entities.name: Tortoise
entities.subtitle: The Mock Turtle’s old teacher
entities.body: Tortoise is the name the Mock Turtle gives to his old schoolteacher, an old Turtle from his school in the sea.
